description: Literature-informed local linear DP approximation to Resin L / GL1. Reported proof-yield points and initial tensile hardening only; damage and fibers are project demonstrations. Not a reproduction of the published paraboloid model or full experimental curve.

units.length_scale: same reference length unit as solver domain lengths; no implicit mm or micrometres

parameter_provenance.E_nu: Roetsch et al. 2025, tables 1/5; tensile modulus, common isotropic elasticity approximation
parameter_provenance.friction_yield_stress: Own linear-cone conversion of reported tensile/compressive yield 39/81 MPa. Tensile reported yield is a 0.1% permanent-strain proof point, not infinitesimal first plasticity.
parameter_provenance.dilatancy: Volume-preserving flow inference from published plastic Poisson ratio 0.5; not independently fitted in this DP model
parameter_provenance.hardening: Own local slope conversion H=(1+alpha/3)*delta_sigma/delta_plastic_strain from first two tensile table-6 points; assumes equivalent plastic strain equals axial plastic strain for uniaxial beta=0 DP. Source law and later hardening differ.
parameter_provenance.damage: Project demonstration, not fitted to this resin: threshold 0.02, softening 0.015, length 0.03 in reference domain units; no adopted fracture energy
parameter_provenance.fiber: Existing project demonstration, not a measured composite constituent

source.title: Investigation of Epoxy Resin under Uniaxial, Biaxial, and Triaxial Quasi-Static Loads

limits: Small-strain, rate-independent idealization of specific published tests
Two yield points do not reproduce the paraboloid surface or observed torsion yield
A constant H fits only the initial tabulated segment; source tension and shear evolve differently
Damage length and law remain uncalibrated; source length statements disagree
Perfectly bonded elastic fibers; no interface fracture
